2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Denver’s healthy offense challenges a Kansas City unit managing key Week 1 absences
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Denver arrives at Arrowhead with Marvin Mims Jr. practicing fully, while Kansas City has Patrick Mahomes trending toward the start but remains without some full-strength pieces, including Josh Simmons and Chamarri Conner missing practice. The Broncos can pressure Kansas City by forcing long drives and making the Chiefs protect consistently against Denver’s front. Kansas City’s answer is still Mahomes’ ability to solve pressure and create explosives. The matchup turns on whether Denver can make the Chiefs play methodically rather than letting broken plays become chunk gains.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Denver can tighten the game by winning early downs and forcing Kansas City into longer possessions, but Mahomes remains the clearest individual counter to disciplined pressure.
